strategy.name: Inherited nuclei plus old marginal terranes and dated gateways
strategy.reason: It preserves the visibly different six-body envelopes while eliminating the two artificial devices that caused the prior historical failure: the late-looking C2 rigid offset and pasted Earth-reference guard sectors. The bounded dated and physical suites now pass after local eastern-route repairs.

motion_policy.alternate_frame_role: MULLER2022 is a sensitivity check where the deep-time frame materially diverges; it is not silently mixed into the primary reconstruction.
motion_policy.rule: Relative rotations needed for silhouette design must finish before the human-route ledger begins. Local uplift, subsidence, erosion, volcanism, shelf emergence and sea-level response may continue afterward.

present_geometry_controls.coordinate_frame: reference/source coordinates prior to Proposal 4 rotation
notes: JX1 is an oblique composite junction province rather than an Earth-Panama copy.
The C4 corridor moves the ancestral exit to a lower-latitude marginal route instead of the approximately 60S old exit anchor.
The C5 shelf head's western root overlaps the resized C3 margin; its eastern nose stays separated from the island chain.
Two small old stepping terranes reduce the actual coastline water gaps to approximately 54.7, 28.3 and 75.0 km while all three channels remain water.

unresolved_constraints.question: What time-dependent ice and local climate solution produces the bounded C4 peripheral-refugia behavior?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: The 32-46S corridor passes the simplified ice/refugia scenario without requiring a polar-interior route.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Do not redraw C4 unless a higher-fidelity ice/elevation model specifically fails the corridor.

unresolved_constraints.question: What local relative-sea-level and sill history realizes the bounded H06/H07/H10 northern accessibility states?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: A -70 m class sill and amplitude-bounded sea-level states produce the required two founding windows plus intermittent contacts.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with bathymetry, eustasy, isostasy and geoid sensitivity; do not invent new continent-scale motion.

unresolved_constraints.question: What current, wind, bathymetric and voyage solution realizes the repaired eastern crossing network?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: Actual regenerated coastline gaps are approximately 54.7, 28.3 and 75.0 km; island areas exceed 350 and 500 km2 targets and deep sills remain submerged in the bounded test.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with local bathymetric sections and voyage/current modeling; do not add more islands unless that model specifically fails.

unresolved_constraints.question: What detailed C3 relief, drainage and hydroclimate produce the bounded intermittent-contact state machine?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: The pass/plateau state model permits limited contact and strong restriction without a universal coastal bypass.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with relief/drainage/climate reconstruction, not coastline changes unless that model specifically fails.

unresolved_constraints.question: What exact plate/block partition generates all six final envelopes and the new marginal provinces while preserving crustal mass, old sutures and acceptable ocean/land redistribution?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: Regenerated Strategy A land fraction is about 31.1%, approximately 7.7% more land than the generalized reference; this is geometrically plausible but large enough that climate equivalence cannot be assumed.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Requires a dedicated plate reconstruction and crustal inventory. A failure here may justify local margin revision or Strategy B, but not ad hoc late motion.

fallback_strategy.trigger: Use only if Strategy A later fails a high-fidelity dated plate/block test that cannot be repaired locally.
fallback_strategy.description: Promote the C1-C2 junction to a separately reconstructed microplate and permit modest pre-1.9 Ma rotations of both adjacent bodies around it.
fallback_strategy.retry_limit: one materially different fallback after Strategy A; preserve the best valid state if B also fails
